fields.Name: Run Integration Sync
fields.Description: Triggers a data sync for a Company Integration. Pulls or pushes records according to entity maps, field maps, and watermarks configured for the integration.

fields.Name: CompanyIntegrationID
fields.Description: ID of the Company Integration to sync

fields.Name: TriggerType
fields.Description: How the sync was triggered: Manual, Scheduled, or Webhook (defaults to Manual)

fields.Name: FullSync
fields.Description: Set to 'true' to force a full sync ignoring watermarks

fields.Name: EntityMapIDs
fields.Description: Comma-separated list of EntityMapIDs to restrict the sync to specific entity maps

fields.Name: RecordsProcessed
fields.Description: Total number of records processed during sync

fields.Name: RecordsCreated
fields.Description: Number of new records created

fields.Name: RecordsUpdated
fields.Description: Number of existing records updated

fields.Name: RecordsDeleted
fields.Description: Number of records deleted

fields.Name: RecordsErrored
fields.Description: Number of records that encountered errors

fields.Name: RecordsSkipped
fields.Description: Number of records that were skipped

fields.Name: ErrorSummary
fields.Description: JSON string containing details of the first 10 errors encountered
Sync completed successfully with no errors
Sync completed but some records encountered errors
Required parameter CompanyIntegrationID was not provided
An unexpected error occurred during sync execution

fields.Name: Bootstrap SQL Server Integration From Backup
fields.Description: Bootstraps a large SQL Server integration by restoring an Azure Blob backup (or local disk backup) into a temporary staging database, executing high-speed local ETL into target MemberJunction tables, seeding watermarks to BackupStartDate, and tearing down staging.
fields.DriverClass: Bootstrap SQL Server Integration From Backup

fields.Name: CompanyIntegrationID
fields.Description: ID of the Company Integration record defining credentials, schemas, and table mappings

fields.Name: BackupUrls
fields.Description: Comma-separated or JSON array of Azure Blob URLs or local disk paths to the backup stripe files (.bak)

fields.Name: SasToken
fields.Description: Shared Access Signature token for authenticating against the Azure Blob Storage container (not required for local disk)

fields.Name: StorageCredentialID
fields.Description: ID of the MJ: Credentials record whose SasToken (or Secret/Key) value holds the container SAS token; the SQL Server credential is always created from the resolved token. Either this or SasToken is required for Azure Blob sources

fields.Name: StagingDatabaseName
fields.Description: Name of the temporary staging database to restore into. If omitted, defaults to MJ_Staging_<IntegrationName>_<Timestamp>. Returned as an output with the name actually used (the database is retained when DropStagingDbOnComplete is false)

fields.Name: DropStagingDbOnComplete
fields.Description: Whether to automatically drop the staging database upon successful ETL completion. Default is true

fields.Name: BatchSize
fields.Description: Number of rows per batch for chunked ETL transfers. Default is 500,000

fields.Name: EntityMapIDs
fields.Description: Optional JSON array of specific Company Integration Entity Map IDs to bootstrap. If omitted, all active maps are processed

fields.Name: TargetDataFileDirectory
fields.Description: Directory path on the SQL Server host where staging database .mdf/.ndf data files should be relocated

fields.Name: TargetLogFileDirectory
fields.Description: Directory path on the SQL Server host where staging database .ldf log files should be relocated

fields.Name: TruncateTargetBeforeLoad
fields.Description: Set to 'true' to truncate target tables before loading, allowing safe re-runs. If false and target table contains rows, the map load fails.

fields.Name: BackupStartDate
fields.Description: The exact UTC BackupStartDate extracted from the backup file header, used to seed sync watermarks

fields.Name: TotalRowsTransferred
fields.Description: Total count of records transferred from staging tables into target MemberJunction tables across all entity maps

fields.Name: TablesProcessed
fields.Description: Number of entity map tables loaded into their target tables

fields.Name: DurationSeconds
fields.Description: Total execution duration in seconds covering restore, ETL, watermark seeding, and teardown

fields.Name: StagingDatabaseDropped
fields.Description: Boolean indicating whether the staging database was successfully dropped
Database successfully restored from backup, ETL completed into target tables, and watermarks seeded
Required parameters (CompanyIntegrationID or BackupUrls) were missing or invalid
An error occurred during backup header inspection, database restore, schema verification, ETL data transfer, or watermark seeding

fields.Name: Restore SQL Server Backup To Staging
fields.Description: First phase of seeding a SQL Server integration from a backup archive: restores the backup (Azure Blob URLs or local paths) into a named staging database and stops. A server-side job runs this, then Load SQL Server Integration From Staging, then Drop SQL Server Staging Database.
fields.DriverClass: Restore SQL Server Backup To Staging

fields.Name: CompanyIntegrationID
fields.Description: ID of the Company Integration record being seeded

fields.Name: BackupUrls
fields.Description: Comma-separated or JSON array of Azure Blob URLs or local disk paths to the backup stripe files (.bak)

fields.Name: StagingDatabaseName
fields.Description: Name of the staging database to restore into; it must not already exist

fields.Name: SasToken
fields.Description: Shared Access Signature token for authenticating against the Azure Blob Storage container (not required for local disk)

fields.Name: StorageCredentialID
fields.Description: ID of the MJ: Credentials record whose SasToken (or Secret/Key) value holds the container SAS token; used when SasToken is not supplied

fields.Name: TargetDataFileDirectory
fields.Description: Directory path on the SQL Server host where staging database .mdf/.ndf data files should be relocated

fields.Name: TargetLogFileDirectory
fields.Description: Directory path on the SQL Server host where staging database .ldf log files should be relocated

fields.Name: ProgressRunID
fields.Description: ID of the integration progress run to report the restore stages to

fields.Name: BackupStartDate
fields.Description: The exact UTC start date (ISO) of the backup, from the backup file header; the load phase seeds sync watermarks to it

fields.Name: BackupDatabaseName
fields.Description: Name of the source database recorded in the backup header

fields.Name: StagingDatabaseName
fields.Description: Name of the restored staging database

fields.Name: ContainerUrl
fields.Description: Storage container whose SQL Server credential was registered for the restore (empty for local paths); pass it to the load or drop phase to remove the credential
Backup restored into the staging database
A required parameter (CompanyIntegrationID, BackupUrls or StagingDatabaseName) was missing
A parameter was invalid, such as BackupUrls containing no valid URL or path
An error occurred during backup header inspection or database restore

fields.Name: Load SQL Server Integration From Staging
fields.Description: Second phase of seeding a SQL Server integration from a backup archive: loads every active entity map's table from a restored staging database into the target MemberJunction tables and seeds the loaded maps' watermarks to the backup start date.
fields.DriverClass: Load SQL Server Integration From Staging

fields.Name: CompanyIntegrationID
fields.Description: ID of the Company Integration record being seeded

fields.Name: StagingDatabaseName
fields.Description: Name of the restored staging database; it must exist

fields.Name: BackupStartDate
fields.Description: UTC start date (ISO) of the backup, as reported by the restore phase; watermarks are seeded to it

fields.Name: BatchSize
fields.Description: Number of rows per batch for chunked ETL transfers. Default is 500,000; 0 loads unchunked

fields.Name: TruncateTargetBeforeLoad
fields.Description: Set to 'true' to truncate target tables before loading, allowing safe re-runs. If false and a target table contains rows, the map load fails.

fields.Name: EntityMapIDs
fields.Description: Optional comma-separated or JSON array of Company Integration Entity Map IDs to restrict the load to. If omitted, all active maps are loaded

fields.Name: DropStagingDbOnComplete
fields.Description: Whether to drop the staging database after a successful load. Default is false

fields.Name: ContainerUrl
fields.Description: Storage container whose SQL Server credential is dropped together with the staging database

fields.Name: ProgressRunID
fields.Description: ID of the integration progress run to report the load stages to

fields.Name: BackupStartDate
fields.Description: The backup start date the watermarks were seeded to

fields.Name: StagingDatabaseName
fields.Description: Name of the staging database that was loaded

fields.Name: TablesProcessed
fields.Description: Number of entity map tables loaded into their target tables

fields.Name: TotalRowsTransferred
fields.Description: Total count of records transferred from staging tables into target MemberJunction tables across all maps

fields.Name: DurationSeconds
fields.Description: Total execution duration in seconds covering the load and watermark seeding

fields.Name: StagingDatabaseDropped
fields.Description: Boolean indicating whether the staging database was dropped after the load
Staging data loaded into the target tables and watermarks seeded
A required parameter (CompanyIntegrationID, StagingDatabaseName or BackupStartDate) was missing
BackupStartDate was not a valid date
The named staging database does not exist on this instance
An error occurred during the ETL load or watermark seeding; the staging database is kept so the load can be retried

fields.Name: Drop SQL Server Staging Database
fields.Description: Last phase of seeding a SQL Server integration from a backup archive: drops the staging database and, when the restore read from storage, its SQL Server storage credential. Dropping a database that no longer exists succeeds.

fields.Name: StagingDatabaseName
fields.Description: Name of the staging database to drop

fields.Name: ContainerUrl
fields.Description: Storage container whose SQL Server credential is dropped too

fields.Name: CompanyIntegrationID
fields.Description: ID of the Company Integration record; recorded on the progress run's manifest only

fields.Name: ProgressRunID
fields.Description: ID of the integration progress run to report the cleanup stage to

fields.Name: StagingDatabaseDropped
fields.Description: 1 when the staging database was dropped (or was already absent)
Staging database dropped
Parameter StagingDatabaseName was missing
An error occurred while dropping the staging database or its storage credential

fields.Name: List Azure Backup Blobs
fields.Description: Queries an Azure Blob Storage container via the Azure REST API to discover available backup (.bak) files for bootstrap integration.

fields.Name: ContainerUrl
fields.Description: Azure Blob Storage container URL (e.g. https://storage.blob.core.windows.net/backups)

fields.Name: SasToken
fields.Description: Shared Access Signature token for Azure Blob container authentication

fields.Name: StorageCredentialID
fields.Description: MJ: Credentials record ID storing the SAS token

fields.Name: Prefix
fields.Description: Optional blob name prefix filter (e.g. 'AdventureWorks_')

fields.Name: Blobs
fields.Description: JSON-serialized array of { Name, Url, SizeBytes, LastModified }

fields.Name: BlobCount
fields.Description: Total number of blobs matching query
Successfully retrieved blob list from Azure container
Required parameter ContainerUrl was not provided
ContainerUrl is not a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL
Failed to list blobs from Azure Storage container due to authentication, network, or REST API error

fields.Name: Inspect SQL Server Backup
fields.Description: Inspects multi-stripe SQL Server backup files (.bak) from Azure Blob Storage or local disk by executing RESTORE HEADERONLY and RESTORE FILELISTONLY.

fields.Name: CompanyIntegrationID
fields.Description: ID of the Company Integration being inspected

fields.Name: BackupUrls
fields.Description: Single backup URL/path or comma-separated list of URLs/paths for multi-stripe backup sets

fields.Name: SasToken
fields.Description: Shared Access Signature token for Azure Blob container access

fields.Name: StorageCredentialID
fields.Description: MJ: Credentials record ID storing the SAS token

fields.Name: BackupStartDate
fields.Description: Point-in-time timestamp (ISO UTC) when the backup began

fields.Name: DatabaseName
fields.Description: Original database name recorded in the backup header

fields.Name: BackupSizeBytes
fields.Description: Total backup size in bytes

fields.Name: Stripes
fields.Description: Number of media-set files (stripes) the backup spans

fields.Name: Files
fields.Description: JSON-serialized array of logical and physical file records { LogicalName, PhysicalName, Type, SizeBytes }
Successfully inspected backup header and file list
Required parameter CompanyIntegrationID or BackupUrls was not provided
